project_info.theme: Toyota Camry HEV premium pricing announcement

main_subject.detail: A clean premium pricing poster featuring a silver Toyota Camry HEV photographed from a rear-side three-quarter angle on a sunlit urban road. Large road-projected typography reads 'GIA MOI TU 1,32 TY'. Two model price plates below say 'CAMRY HEV PREMIUM CHI TU 1.320.000.000 VND' and 'CAMRY HEV LUXURY CHI TU 1.460.000.000 VND'. Toyota logo is top left and 'Move your world' appears bottom left.
main_subject.style: Minimal premium sedan pricing poster with road-projection typography, polished product photography, and upscale urban calm

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / GIA MOI TU 1,32 TY / CAMRY HEV PREMIUM / CHI TU 1.320.000.000 VND / CAMRY HEV LUXURY / CHI TU 1.460.000.000 VND / Move your world
items: Top Left: Toyota logo over a clean urban plaza edge
Top Right: Open paved plaza and landscaped shrubs behind the car
Bottom Left: 'Move your world' script and the left model price plate
Bottom Right: Right model price plate for Camry HEV Luxury

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal automotive pricing poster with minimal premium art direction

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Camry HEV premium pricing announcement. Centerpiece is a silver Toyota Camry HEV shown from a rear-side angle on a clean urban road. Background is a minimal modern plaza with landscaping and bright daylight. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, giant road-projected text 'GIA MOI TU 1,32 TY', the model price labels 'CAMRY HEV PREMIUM CHI TU 1.320.000.000 VND' and 'CAMRY HEV LUXURY CHI TU 1.460.000.000 VND', and the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal automotive pricing poster with minimal premium art direction, natural premium automotive daylight, clean reflections and sharp shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
